verdict.rationale: Pipedrive clearly ships versioned APIs: v1 and v2 each have OpenAPI 3 specs, endpoints are versioned in their paths, and a v2 migration guide recommends moving to v2. No evidence documents a formal deprecation policy, such as sunset timelines, notice periods or deprecation headers, so only half the story is shown. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy with timelines/notice periods, deprecation signaling in API responses, changelog evidence, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: you can always import our OpenAPI 3 specification files (available for both v1 and v2 APIs) into your tool of choice
Where available, please use API v2 for the best performance and developer experience.
